Deciding whether to hold a remote hearing

19. It is ultimately a balancing exercise for the judge as to whether or not a particular hearing
should proceed remotely, but it is very important to listen to the views of the parties and their
representatives.
509

20. It is necessary to be very careful if arranging a “hybrid” hearing that the arrangements are
not procedurally unfair. For example, requiring parties to attend the courtroom in person if
their legal representative can only attend remotely is likely to be unfair.

510 It may also be
unsatisfactory for one side to attend in person while the other side attends remotely.
